public_metadata.title: Dana White’s “Dumbest Idea” Became a $7.7B Deal
public_metadata.description:
Dana White called entering the fight business “probably the dumbest idea ever.”
UFC was failing, boxing looked unbeatable—and then storylines plus rule-breaking changed the outcome. Independent reporting confirms the $2M-to-about-$4B progression, while TKO reports a $7.7B Paramount agreement. Would you have made the bet?`

#DanaWhite #UFC #Business
